description: Pakistan National Shipping Corporation describes itself as the country's leading maritime enterprise, offering integrated shipping, logistics and marine engineering services. It manages a diversified fleet and states that it operates across the tanker, bulk, chartering and container segments. Beyond shipping, its services include technical and commercial vessel management, ship repairs, agency and stevedoring, port logistics, ship and port equipment repair, and commercial property leasing.
headOffice: PNSC Building, M.T. Khan Road, Karachi, Pakistan
